icons.name: select-all
icons.heading: Select all
icons.description: Everything is selected. Light: the selection boundary runs on from the corner bracket round the right side, the bottom and up the left until it closes, and each object pops as the boundary passes it, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, then the first one as the loop closes. Strong: the boundary accelerates round in one stroke and closes with a hit that makes the whole selection pulse, and the objects pop bigger with a rebound. The reverse retracts the boundary to the bracket without a pop.

Light: the lid lifts, a document card slides out from under it and drops into the box (clipped at the rim), and the lid follows it down with a hit and a small bounce. Strong: the lid lifts with a tilt, two cards drop in turn, and the lid slams with a bounce and a settle. The box never moves.

icons.name: target
icons.heading: Target
icons.description: The reticle locks on. Light: the four ticks close in on the mark and stop with a hit, the ring tightens a beat after them and the centre dot pops as the lock lands, then the reticle releases back out with a small rebound. Strong: the ticks first swing a third of a quarter-turn off and open wide, searching, then snap back and close in harder, the ring tightens more, the dot pops bigger and everything settles in two beats.
